Episode 242. Eltiot(1)
Two days had passed since the battle in Meisil.
In the meantime, the Vamel Alliance moved various devices left by the royal family and the bodies of the Blue Plutonian tribe to Tikan from the uninhabited island hideout of the Rutero Federation.
In the process, the Red Owl and Mort had space-jumped more than twenty times, but fortunately, they were not exposed to Zipple.
They destroyed all the facilities that were too large to move. They had taken care of Ailan Vermont, the Solar Theocracy, and since leaving them might make them useful, they had to do so.
"If Luke hadn't been so seriously injured, it wouldn't have been easy to take the spoils."
"I think so too, Ameris. It's a pity we couldn't bring the entire Blue Plutonian tribe's transportation device. It seemed like it could be helpful in many ways."
Though inferior to the Red Plutonian tribe, the Blue Plutonian tribe's space jumping was a technology far ahead of the present time.
Jin had hoped that it might be a clue to extracting Lafrarosa's siblings.
"Still, we've brought some parts that are presumed to be the core, so if Qwaul and Valeria analyze them well, it will be helpful somehow."
Jin nodded.
Although they were saying it was a pity, the Vamel Alliance had gained more benefits from the battle in Meisil than any other power.

Even unlike the Red Plutonian tribe, the royal family, or the Solar Theocracy, they had not suffered any damage. The Red Plutonian tribe had lost 4 cities and Uss to Elona and lost many fleets in Meisil, with two airborne fortresses partially damaged.
The royal family virtually perished with only Ailan surviving and was absorbed into the Solar Theocracy, and Luke of the Solar Theocracy was mortally wounded.
'Luke... Next time I fight that guy, it won't be as easy as this time.'
Old Demon King's Warrior Luke.
Jin pondered, recalling his martial prowess. He was unsure whether he could win in a one-on-one fight without any conditions.
Whoever won would be pushed to the brink of death. Jin considered Luke a formidable opponent, even beyond Phaelito.
'Whether it's Luke or Lady Elona. I should always avoid a one-on-one fight with a star-level being. I need to find out more about him and the Solar Theocracy.'
At that moment, Jett found Jin.
"My lord! The Blue Plutonian noble has awakened."
"Oh. Contact Lady Luna, she said she wanted to meet him personally."
"Understood, my lord!"
Eltiot had been unconscious for the past two days. Jin and Ameris immediately went to the infirmary.
Eltiot was sitting on the bed, staring out of the window with a vacant expression.
"Eltiot, the ancient Blue Plutonian warrior god. You're finally awake."
"You are...."
Eltiot tilted his head as if he didn't recognize Jin.
"Don't you remember me? You used to call me brother when I rescued you."
"And I am, who?"
"What?"
"Where is... this place?"
"Eltiot, what are you talking about? Don't you remember anything? Look at me, it's Ameris. The one you so despised."
"Ameris...? I can't remember anything...."
Ameris sighed and approached Eltiot, holding his face, feeling his pulse, and examining him.
"The pulse is surprisingly stable, and the power emanating from the heart is majestic, but there seems to be a problem with his memory."
"Ugh."
"This... once a mighty being that terrorized the world has come to such a bitter end."
Ameris looked on with an expression of sorrow, as if viewing a broken old comrade.

As could be gleaned from the phrase 'the one you so despised,' Ameris was, in fact, no less than an enemy to the Blue Plutonian tribe. Both the Blue Plutonian and Red Plutonian tribes had been submerged in the annals of history due to her rebellion.
"Joking around, big snake. I didn't expect you to look at me with that face."
Suddenly, Eltiot smiled slyly.
"What?"

"It's rather amusing to see one who was so ruthless when sealing us now looking sad, isn't it? If you feel sorry, offer your neck now. Offer a ritual with that head to console the souls of my brothers. Even stuff money into your nostrils, like those lesser mortals do."
Ameris was momentarily speechless with astonishment. Soon, she shrugged her shoulders and glared at Eltiot.
"I momentarily forgot that you have a cheeky side. You just woke up in this situation, and you're joking?"

"The immortal, whom I believed to be a comrade, sealed the entire underground despite our pleas, and I, having lost my power and fallen asleep, became a prey of the Melka tribe. Now, I've awakened in a strange land on the surface, without a single brother. How can I endure if I don't make a joke? Big snake."
Eltiot stood up and looked at Ameris.
His eyes, deep and firm, sparkled brightly. The dignity of one who had once ruled a world for a long time poured out.
The comrade believed to be immortal.
The Blue Plutonian tribe, unlike the Red Plutonian tribe, insisted that the death of the Sun God must be maintained as is. Therefore, Ameris and they had aimed for the same goal, though not allies.
"Heh, good. I'm glad you've come to your senses. Was it not the right choice when I sealed the underworld then? Do you want to question that decision now?"

"If I had, I would have killed you when you came close to me earlier, Great Serpent. I may have been weakened by long confinement and injury, but you are in the same condition. You too have become as pitiable as I am. Even the powers that the Demon Kings could not easily overcome are nowhere to be found now."
Eltiot turned his gaze to Jin.
"Jin Runcandel. That was your name, wasn't it? In my dazed state, I remember your sister and the enemies calling you that."
"You're right. It seems your memory has fully returned?"

"Not all of it. But I roughly remember who I am and what has happened. You are, in many ways, peculiar. You seem to be a distant descendant of ours, but your appearance is that of a perfect human, you have a shining heart... what on earth are you?"
"I became a part of the Demon King clan as a human. As you said, my brothers seem to be distant descendants of the Blue Spirit clan."
"Are there any left in this world who could be called the descendants of the Red Thunder clan?"
"None."

"Then the winners of the Sun War before the Great Seal were our Blue Spirit clan. Perhaps one of my brothers managed to survive the Great Serpent's gaze... and he left descendants who became your brothers."
Understanding the situation and coping with the shock might be difficult, but Eltiot had already accepted his position.
"But since the Red Thunder clan has been properly resurrected, we could say that the second war has begun. Had you and your sister not arrived in time, I would have been their prey."
"Thanks to Lady Ameris, I was able to perceive the battle in the underworld and find you."

"I still cannot bring myself to thank the Great Serpent. Come on, you must have many questions. How I became a lowly slave to the Melka clan, what I saw and heard from them, how I've come to my senses now."
"I would be grateful for an explanation."

"It's a simple story. I was sealed in a city of our Blue Spirit clan called Nilot in the middle world. A Melka called Iiran Bementra found me and constantly enchanted me. He said he saved our Blue Spirit clan."
The seal had lasted from an age that humans would call 'the beginning' to the present day. Even Eltiot could not maintain a lucid mind all the time.

"I fell for that vile brainwashing in my weakened state. He even showed me the bodies of my brothers... Ah, my brothers' corpses must be here now. Allow me to perform a ritual for them later. You won't be able to use their bodies anyway."
"Of course."
"Anyway, it seems that this Iiran wanted to break me first, then complete the brainwashing with some special device later on."
"He was trying to make something like a Sacred Vessel...?"

"I don't know what a Sacred Vessel is, but it was something that could absolutely control both me and Temar Bementra's mind. It must all be in vain now; I heard it clearly as soon as the Red Thunder clan invaded. Our grand plan has failed. After today, we must hide again and watch for an opportunity for a long time, the Melka said."
"Then the Red Whisperers invaded, and the Emperor abandoned hope and fled, receiving help from the Solar Faith."

"That's right. He intended to use me in a rampage just to buy time. That means my flesh would go to the Red Whisperers, and they would become that much stronger. The Imperial House failed to control the Red Whisperers. They may be trash, but those insignificant Melka managed to pay the proper price for daring to command the Kings' race."
"......Temar Vermont. Is there more you remember about that mine that used the flesh of my ancestor?"

"Nothing more. But the Solar Faith secured that mine. They even came to the battlefield where two air fortresses are. Your ancestor's flesh must be deeply connected to the revival of the Sun God. Otherwise, the Solar Faith would not take such a risk. They lived in our time, so they would know the power of the Kings' race well."
The relationship between Temar's flesh and the revival of the Sun God was something to figure out gradually.
"I see. What are you thinking of doing now, Eltiett? Will you seek revenge?"

"Against the Red Whisperers? Fighting them is just like a daily routine. No need for feelings like resentment. To punish those insane Melka who used me, well, they are practically finished and have been subjugated by the Solar Faith."
"Then it sounds like you're willing to fight with us."
"I plan to repay the favor of saving my life. Besides, you are our distant descendant, so isn't it proper for an ancestor to assist?"
Jin's eyes widened.
He had hoped for something in rescuing him, but he never thought Eltiett would become an ally so easily.
"But...... no, we should talk about this later."
At that moment, Luna entered the room.
"Oh, Eltiett! You seem to be doing much better than I thought. Do you remember who I am? The person who carried you and ran all day after rescuing you from underground."
As soon as Luna came in, Eltiett wore a blank expression again.
"You are...... who? I am...... my head hurts. Who am I?"
"Ah? Could it be amnesia?"
Jin and Ameris feigned ignorance and shrugged their shoulders.
"Hmm, what should we do then? Should Valeria help? No, amnesia is a bit unexpected, isn't it?"
"You guys are really gullible. This is fun to tease."
"Aha...... You're joking, I see. It seems that the youngest and Ameris were fooled earlier. Anyway, nice to meet you; I had a hard time rescuing you with the little one."
Eltiett grinned and took Luna's outstretched hand.
"Yes, nice to meet you, Luna Runcandel...... And you, I have some things to teach you, unlike your sister."
